title: My Peace I Give to You

request.style: English, warm female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, organ, gentle and reassuring, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Advocate the Father sends
In Jesus' name to you
He will teach you all things
And remind you of the way

[Chorus]
Peace I leave with you
My peace I give to you
Not as the world gives
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Do not be afraid

[Verse]
I have told you these things
While I am still with you
The word you hear is from the Father
Who sent me to guide you

[Chorus]
Peace I leave with you
My peace I give to you
Not as the world gives
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Do not be afraid

[Bridge]
He will remind you of everything
I have said to you
You will not be left alone
In the light of the Spirit

[Chorus]
Peace I leave with you
My peace I give to you
Not as the world gives
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Do not be afraid

[Outro]
Do not be afraid
My peace I give to you
